record.body:
## Evidence

R3 and R4 pass as local tests (test_r3_type_error_fails_check, test_r4_error_and_warning_findings_fail_lint) on a temporary copy. The web job has not run in CI yet.

## Consequence

The phase closes on local evidence. The CI observation stays open.

## Follow-up

Push phase/node-ci or main. Then push one branch with a deliberate type error and one with a deliberate lint finding. Confirm both fail the web job, then clear this finding. Add the web job to the required checks on GitHub.

payload.basis: The specification asks for two pushed branches (a deliberate type error and a deliberate lint finding) that fail the web job. Push is a human stop. Local tests prove the same gate behavior.
payload.claim: R3 and R4 CI run observations are pending a push
payload.invalidated_when: A human pushes the branches and the web job fails as expected, or a CI run shows otherwise
